contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG] ; R/ ]SOLI] INVI[CTO COMITI]

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constantine I dating AD310-319. Reece period 15, reverse: SOLI INVICTO COMITI, Sol standing. Obverse: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG]. Reverse: Sol standing with globe. Reverse inscription: ]SOLI] INVI[CTO COMITI]. Mint mark: Illegible. Die axis measurement: 6.00. Dimensions: diameter: 21.06mm; weight: 2.31g
